title: Minecraft Villager
blurb: The Minecraft villager 'hmm' — the confused grunt of gaming's most economically ruthless NPC. It's become the internet's sound for incomprehension and dubious deals alike: play it when someone offers you a terrible trade, when instructions make no sense, or as the response to any question you don't want to answer. Weirdly expressive for a single syllable.
origin: The villager trade grunt from Minecraft (Mojang).
